U.S. Strikes Qeshm Island as Vance Says Iran Won’t Become ‘Forever War’

The U.S. and Iran exchanged attacks on Tuesday in the latest flare-up of the war that the Trump Administration promised would end after the U.S. midterms. American warplanes hit an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island in the crucial Strait of Hormuz waterway. An unnamed official speaking to CNN and other outlets called the strikes “self-defense” in response to alleged “aggression targeting American personnel and assets” by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard …
